subdomains.name: Agathion Subdomain (Good)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Holy Lance with Protective Aura and replace the Good domain's 1st-, 3rd-, and 6th-level spells.

powers.name: Touch of Good
powers.summary: As a standard action, touch a willing creature to grant a sacred bonus equal to half cleric level, minimum +1, on attacks, saves, skill checks, and ability checks for 1 round. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Protective Aura
powers.summary: As a standard action, emit a 30-foot aura that grants allies +2 deflection AC, +2 resistance on saves, and protection from evil for rounds per day equal to cleric level. Rounds need not be consecutive.

subdomains.name: Archon Subdomain (Good)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Holy Lance with Aura of Menace and replace the Good domain's 1st-, 3rd-, and 6th-level spells.

powers.name: Touch of Good
powers.summary: As a standard action, touch a willing creature to grant a sacred bonus equal to half cleric level, minimum +1, on attacks, saves, skill checks, and ability checks for 1 round. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Aura of Menace
powers.summary: As a standard action, emit a 30-foot aura whose enemies take -2 to AC, attacks, and saves for rounds per day equal to cleric level. Rounds need not be consecutive.

subdomains.name: Archon Subdomain (Law)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Staff of Order with Aura of Menace and replace the Law domain's 1st-, 3rd-, and 6th-level spells.

powers.name: Touch of Law
powers.summary: As a standard action, touch a willing creature. For 1 round it treats every d20 result on attacks, saves, skill checks, and ability checks as an 11. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Aura of Menace
powers.summary: As a standard action, emit a 30-foot aura whose enemies take -2 to AC, attacks, and saves for rounds per day equal to cleric level. Rounds need not be consecutive.

subdomains.name: Azata Subdomain (Chaos)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Touch of Chaos with Elysium's Call and replace the Chaos domain's 1st-, 3rd-, and 6th-level spells.

powers.name: Elysium's Call
powers.summary: Touch a creature to free it from enchantments, bolster related saves and escape maneuvers, and let it ignore 5 feet of difficult terrain for rounds equal to half cleric level. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Chaos Blade
powers.summary: As a standard action, give a touched weapon the anarchic special ability for rounds equal to half cleric level. Usable once per day at 8th level, plus once per four levels beyond 8th.

subdomains.name: Azata Subdomain (Good)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Touch of Good with Elysium's Call and replace the Good domain's 1st-, 3rd-, and 6th-level spells.

powers.name: Elysium's Call
powers.summary: Touch a creature to free it from enchantments, bolster related saves and escape maneuvers, and let it ignore 5 feet of difficult terrain for rounds equal to half cleric level. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Holy Lance
powers.summary: As a standard action, give a touched weapon the holy special ability for rounds equal to half cleric level. Usable once per day at 8th level, plus once per four levels beyond 8th.

subdomains.name: Restoration Subdomain (Healing)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Rebuke Death with Restorative Touch and replace the Healing domain's 2nd-, 4th-, and 5th-level spells.

powers.name: Restorative Touch
powers.summary: Touch a creature to remove the dazed, fatigued, shaken, sickened, or staggered condition. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Healer's Blessing
powers.summary: Treat cure spells as empowered, increasing the damage healed by 50%. This does not increase damage dealt to undead or stack with Empower Spell.

subdomains.name: Resurrection Subdomain (Healing)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Healer's Blessing with Gift of Life and replace the Healing domain's 5th-, 7th-, and 9th-level spells.

powers.name: Rebuke Death
powers.summary: As a standard action, touch a living creature below 0 hit points to heal 1d4 damage plus 1 for every two cleric levels. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Gift of Life
powers.summary: Touch a creature dead for no more than 1 minute to return it temporarily for rounds equal to cleric level with hit points equal to half cleric level. Usable once per day at 8th level, plus once per four levels beyond 8th.
